_comment: Class Progression (design doc v3): each class here gets a hard FORK at 'fork_level' into two lanes; classes absent from this file simply level along their base tables. Each lane: 'name' + 'archetype' (the name shown from capstone level on), 'blurb' (shown on the choice card), 'offsets' (permanent adds to the class table: hit = to-hit AND damage, ac = armor class, sp = spell points, detect = trap/secret %), 'passive' (always-on, from the passive list below), 'verb' (the signature action gained at its 'level'), 'capstone' (gained at its 'level'; numbers tunable), 'refinement' (upgrades the verb at its 'level'), and 'rite' (the Level 20 Rite, see below). PASSIVES: weapon_focus (+dmg with a chosen weapon category — the player picks which at the fork), braced_stance (-'reduce' damage taken per hit while a shield is worn), vital_strike, keen_senses, prepared_mind (the Wizard lane's spellbook: only prepared spells are castable; slots = 'slots_base' + max spell level; re-pick freely at each rest), overchannel (the Sorcerer lane: every cast costs 'discount' less SP, floor 1; knows only 'known_per_level' spells per spell level, picked on unlock), blessed_hands (+'heal' HP on every heal spell), sacred_weapon (+'dmg' divine damage on weapon hits). VERBS: rampage, guardians_stand, assassinate, vanish, arcane_insight (once per battle, your action: choose +'hit' to-hit, +'dc' save DC, or +'dmg' spell damage for the rest of the fight), overcast (toggle: pay 'cost_mult'x SP to cast a spell one level higher — +'extra_dice' damage/healing, +'dc_bonus' DC), mercy (free reaction: an ally cut to 0 HP immediately rises with 'dice' + WIS HP), zealous_strike (toggle: each landed melee hit spends 'cost' SP for +'dice' divine damage and 'heal' self-healing). CAPSTONES: rage, bulwark, lethality, set_trap, archmage (once per rest: cast ANY spellbook spell, prepared or not, for ALL remaining SP), twin_surge (once per rest: a spell resolves twice, then you are Exhausted a round), miracle (once per rest, ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: the living are fully healed, the fallen rise at half), divine_inspiration (ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: +'hit'/+'dmg'/+'ac' for 'rounds' rounds). REFINEMENTS: rampage_crits, stand_half_cost, assassinate_low_hp, vanish_free, insight_double (Arcane Insight grants TWO bonus types), overcast_cheap (Overcast costs 1.5x, rounded up), mercy_cures (Mercy also cures one condition), zealous_immunity (a Zealous Strike grants immunity to conditions until your next turn). TESTING TIP: the Playtest Bench (P) banks XP and bumps playstyle counters — the fastest road to any milestone. | NEW (2026-08-29): passives sundered_calm/granite_skin/warding_presence (a passive may carry a 'name' — weapon_focus wears 'Edge Eternal' for the Spellblade); verbs runic_riposte, ward_surge, unyielding, shared_fortitude; capstones whirling_verse, mirror_ward, mountains_heart, deep_roots; refinements riposte_allies, ward_surge_allies, unyielding_allies, fortitude_two; rite verbs crescendo, unbroken_chord, bedrock, hearthfire; counters riposteKills, wardDeflects, unyieldingSaves, alliesFortified. | RANGER (2026-08-29): passives ambidexterity/snap_shot; verbs hunters_surge/volley; capstones storm_of_blades/rain_of_arrows; refinements offhand_free/hawk_on_the_move; rite verbs pack_instinct/true_shot; counters surgeKills/volleyKills.
_xp_comment: XP CURVE (playtest proposal 2026-08-30, replaces the flat legacy 50 x level): XP to reach the NEXT level = base x growth^(level-1), rounded to the nearest 5. With 50/1.3: level 1->2 costs 50, 5->6 costs 145, 10->11 costs 530, 15->16 costs 1,955, 19->20 costs 5,600 - about 24,000 total to reach 20 (the old rule needed only 9,500, so a full-run party hit 20 on floor 13 and skipped the last third of the dungeon). Tune base/growth freely; delete the block to fall back to 50 x level.
_rite_comment: THE LEVEL 20 RITE (doc v3). 'sigil' lists the shared 8x8x8 vocabulary — every hero draws from the same pool. Per lane, 'rite' has: 'ability' (the unique capstone verb — engine knows 'whirlwind' and 'aegis'; name/numbers are CONTENT FLAGS, rename and retune freely), 'tracked' (which playstyle counter gates the title: rampageKills or standSaves), and 'tiers' — three entries, low to high: 'min' (counter needed; thresholds are proposals, doc says TBD pending playtesting) and 'title' (offered wording; the player may re-word it but keeps the tier). Tier 2 grants 'trinket' (an item id); tier 3 also records the lane's vignette-dungeon unlock (the dungeon itself is a later build).

sigil_art._comment: The visual sigil layers (generated by tools/genart.py from data/art_manifest.json — regenerate any piece there). Each vocabulary word above maps to a white-on-transparent image the engine TINTS with the color hex and composites (shape under, modifier over). A word with no entry here (or a missing file) simply falls back to words-only — nothing breaks. Dark colors automatically get a pale glow so they read on dark panels.

ability_boost._comment: THE LEVEL-10 ABILITY BOOST (designer ruling 2026-09-02): every class, every lane, gets +1 to ONE ability of the player's choice at each level listed. This is the ONLY way an ability rises after creation — no item in the game grants ability scores any more, so the race you picked keeps mattering. Add more levels to the list (e.g. [10, 20]) or raise 'amount' freely.

thief._comment: Doc v3 Thief. wizard._comment: Doc v3 Wizard, magic v3 (2026-08-28): every wizard keeps a spellbook from level 1 (classes.json 'spellbook'); the fork decides what becomes of it. The Spellbook lane keeps studying and hunting scrolls (prepared_mind: 'slots_bonus' extra prepared slots). The Raw Gift sets the book aside: 'known_per_level' picks per spell level (from the catalog or the former book), plus one wild pick at each 'bonus_pick_levels'; every cast costs 'discount' less. Numbers here are proposals — tune freely. The Sorcerer archetype name 'Stormcaller' is the designer's call (2026-08-24); the capstone verb name 'Stormsurge' is a CONTENT FLAG.

spellblade._comment: Elven Spellblade (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29): Bladesong (offense) vs Wardsong (defense), a ±1 lean on hit/AC like the Warrior's fork. PASSIVES: weapon_focus wearing the name Edge Eternal (+1 damage with a chosen weapon type — the pick pops at the fork), sundered_calm (+'saves' on every save). VERBS: runic_riposte (a free retaliatory attack whenever a monster's melee blow lands on you; at 18 also when it lands on an ally beside you), ward_surge (a Y/N reaction BEFORE a monster's swing at you resolves: spend 'cost' SP for +'ac' AC and saves against that one attack; at 18 also for an ally beside you). CAPSTONES: whirling_verse (playtest revision v1.1: costs ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' at least, and immediately ends your active Stance; 'rounds' rounds of one free extra strike per landed weapon hit — the all-in gamble), mirror_ward ('rounds' rounds: 'reflect' of every melee wound is thrown back at the attacker; you cannot move while it holds). Tracked: riposteKills / wardDeflects (surges that turned a hit into a miss + wounds reflected).

stoneshaper._comment: Dwarven Stoneshaper (companion doc v1, 2026-08-29): Bulwark (personal) vs Hearthstone (shared), trading AC against spell points like the Priest's fork. PASSIVES: granite_skin (−'reduce' damage from every un-elemental blow), warding_presence (+'saves' on every save for allies standing beside you). VERBS: unyielding (a blow that would drop you to 0 HP leaves you at 1 instead — UNCAPPED per the doc; at 18 also for an ally beside you), shared_fortitude ('cost' SP: one ally gains 'dice' + your CON of absorbed damage for the battle; at 18 two allies for the same cost). CAPSTONES: mountains_heart ('rounds' rounds: every wound halved, crits cannot land — while your hit/damage bonus is 0 and you cannot move), deep_roots (once per rest, ALL remaining SP, 'min_sp' minimum: every AC/save/resist buff on you is copied to the whole party for 'rounds' rounds). Tracked: unyieldingSaves / alliesFortified (allies fortified, buffed, or sheltered by Deep Roots). Monsters never crit in this engine — Mountain's Heart's crit immunity is recorded for the day they do.

ranger._comment: Half-Elven Ranger (companion doc v1): Way of the Wolf (two blades) vs Way of the Hawk (the bow). The lean lives in the style PENALTIES, not the stat tables (doc's deliberate deviation): no 'offsets'. PASSIVES: ambidexterity (off-hand penalty 4 → 'penalty' 2; +'dmg' with one-handed melee weapons), snap_shot (point-blank penalty → 'point_blank' 0; +'dmg' with bows). VERBS: hunters_surge (a stance: while ON each attack action spends 'cost' SP so the off-hand matches the main hand blow for blow), volley (a bow kill grants a free shot at another foe in range — chains while kills and arrows last). CAPSTONES: storm_of_blades (ALL remaining SP, min 1: 'rounds' rounds of a free off-hand strike after every main-hand hit at no penalty, +'dmg' on every attack), rain_of_arrows ('rounds' rounds: every shot also strikes every foe within 'spread' squares of the target, one arrow per foe struck; you cannot move). REFINEMENTS: offhand_free (no off-hand penalty at all), hawk_on_the_move (steady bows shoot after moving). Tracked: surgeKills (kills during Hunter's Surge / Storm of Blades) / volleyKills. Titles: the 1e ladder Scout / Pathfinder / Ranger Lord, shared by both lanes.
